lines: One day, after school.
With nothing else on my plate, I decided I would head on over to the library for a bit.
It was a school library, but it was so huge that it occupied several underground floors of the school building with all sorts of books that belonged to Gosha.
And since this was the veritable stronghold of the Taimanin, a substantial amount of books on ninja and ninja arts were stored there.
The range of the collection was pretty broad. From ancient books and scrolls on secret techniques, to the latest research reports related to the Taimanin.
There were also books, if not many, on the demons and the Devildom, and you could learn all sorts of knowledge such as their natures, abilities, and even counter-measures against them.
Most of the books were freely accessible to students,
but apparently, some books required permission to read, and some were so valuable and dangerous that you needed Asagi-sensei's supervision to read them.
There was even a department dedicated to the maintenance and restoration of old books with advanced equipment comparable to that of a research institution.
At one time, I  frequented this place to study the demonic power that I'd awakened to, but that research led right into a brick wall so to say.
That day, I was just aimlessly hanging around one of the floors with old volumes while reading books that caught my eye.
Me
And turn right at the next shelf, right?
With a number of books under my arms, I walked from bookshelf to bookshelf.
The library was ridiculously large, and the books were heavy.
Just returning them to the shelves felt like quite a bit of work.
And just as I was thinking like that, yet another book caught my attention.
Me
"Secrets of Nakajima Style Artillery: Water Arts," huh?
It was a book written on artillery at the end of the Edo period around the Tenpo era. In other words, matchlocks and canons of the time, as well as how to apply water arts to them.
Nakajima Style was one of the most prominent Edo artilleries, which even the Oshio Heihachiro studied.
It was quite intriguing that rather than fire arts which were more compatible with guns, they had left behind the secret techniques of water arts which weakened fire instead.
Me
Could be useful someday.
After putting back one of the books I was carrying, I took the artillery book under my arm instead.
I replaced other books with new ones as well before going back to the reading space. And there...
I caught sight of a girl.
She was alone in that vast library, absorbed in her reading.
Me
(Ms. Bookworm... she's here again...)
Very few people would indulge in reading on a floor this deep.
I would have been the only student among them.
That's why I knew all the faces.
Yes, she was one of them.
Though I'd never spoken to her.
I didn't even know her name.
She was always dressed in casual wear.
Perhaps she was in fact a student and had just come back after changing at home?
She was such a mysterious girl.
I had no idea if she was aware of me, but to me, her face was already familiar.
It would have been easy to talk to her, but I hadn't.
I preferred to be alone in places like this.
And I'm sure it was the same for her.
That's why I just contented myself with secretly calling her the "Library's Ms. Bookworm" in my mind.
I always felt somehow nostalgic whenever I saw Ms. Bookworm.
Maybe it was because I was feeling a sense of fellowship from her as we always shared the same space in the library.
Strangely enough, I'd only ever seen Ms. Bookworm here in this library, and she was always alone.
I'd never even caught sight of her entering or leaving, let alone seen her outside of the school.
She was impossible to find when you wanted to. And before you knew it, she was there one moment and gone the next.
It felt like she was the specter of a girl who appeared in the library to read her beloved books.
If that was actually the case, she might stop showing up altogether if I disturbed her.
I hardly wanted that so I thought it best to simply enjoy her company from afar.
ーー
Me
Oh...
A familiar melody began to play throughout the quiet library.
It was a sign that they were about to close.
The librarian here was such an impatient person and would try to close the door as soon as possible.
Dilly-dally too long and you could end up locked inside until morning.
I was still in the middle of reading, but I closed the book and started to get ready to go home.
Me
(What about Ms. Bookworm...?)
Of course, she was nowhere to be found.
She'd already disappeared just as she always had.
And I was the only one left.
I quickly put the books back and hurried out of the library.
It was already evening.
And by the time I arrived home, the sun had long since set.
Sakura
Oh! You're finally back! Welcome ho～me!!
Unusually enough, Sakura was waiting for me at the gate.
Ever since the Brain Flayer incident from some time ago, she'd been a freeloader at my mansion but that didn't mean she'd usually wait for me to return.
She was either lounging around in her room or playing my games without permission.
Sakura
Jeez! You're so late, Fuma-kun!
Me
Wait, did we have plans?
Sakura
That's not it! Looky here!
Sakura shoved the letter in her hand toward me.
Me
A letter?
Sakura
It's for you, Fuma-kun! See? See?
My name was indeed written on the front, and when I turned it over, it was sealed with Western-style wax.
Sakura
This letter's super weird! It wouldn't open at all, no matter what I did!
Me
Huh?
Sakura
I couldn't open it by hand, so I used a paper-knife, but that didn't work either. I even used my ninjato but it couldn't even make a scratch on it!
Sakura
It's amazing, right!? So strange!
Me
Yeah, it's amazing, and strange for sureーwait, that's an invasion of privacy you know?!
Sakura
It's a letter from a girl, isn't it Fuma-kun!? Of course I wanna read it first, you cheater!
Me
What are you talking about!? Besides, what makes you think it's from a girl anyway?
Sakura
Because of this! Look!
What Sakura pointed at was a red lipstick kiss mark.
And there was a signature written in small letters along with it.
It said "Chevalier."
Me
Chevalier...
Sakura
Now, come clean, Fuma-kun. Who's this Chevalier!? It won't do you any good to hide it from me?
Sakura was grinning as she playfully flapped the letter in front of me.
Me
I don't have anything to hide. She's an alchemist from Tokyo Kingdom.
Sakura
Whaaaa～? An alchemist?
I explained that we had gone to Tokyo Kingdom in search of books about the power of demons.
And that while we were there we'd become acquainted with Chevalier during the battle with local gangs who had suddenly attacked us.
Sakura
Huh～? That's it?
Me
That's it. I asked her to search for some books at the time, so she must have written this to tell me she found them.
In other words, Chevalier seemed to have found books related to my ability to regenerate with demonic power.
Sakura
Oh, so then why's there a kiss mark on it? Hmm～, something smells fishyyy.
Me
Would you relax? I have no idea about that kiss mark. Maybe it's just for decoration or something. Anyway, don't go snooping in other people's mail in the first place.
I snatched the letter away from Sakura and tried to open the wax seal with a knife.
Sakura
I told you, didn't I?! It won't open!
*slit!*
Sakura
Huuuuuuh!?
Me
Oh, would you look at that? Opens just fine.
Sakura
But, it didn't open no matter what I did earlier... Huh? This is so weird!
Sakura was grumbling with her head tilted in confusion, but I ignored her and checked what was inside.
Chevalier
"To the human who showed interest in the tomes of Chevalier,"
Chevalier
"Curiosity is one of the most perpetual characteristics of a powerful intellect."
Chevalier
"I wonder if you still have the same heart as Chevalier's?"
Chevalier
"If so, come at once. Chevalier will bestow upon you a source of knowledge that will be an antidote for your fears."
Chevalier
"Friendship is one of humanity's greatest pleasures. Remember, Chevalier is also looking forward to our reunion."
It was an incredibly roundabout way of writing, but the gist was that she'd found a book I was looking for and wanted me to come see her at once.
The letter continued.
Chevalier
"By the way, did you know? Most women's letters contain the most important information in the P.S."
Chevalier
"So you should read Chevalier's P.S. with care."
Chevalier
"P.S. This letter bears the Sandman's Curse."
Chevalier
"Only you, the one whom Chevalier has found intriguing, can read it. That's the way letters between a man and a woman are supposed to be."
Chevalier
"Any insensitive person who tries to interfere with it shall fall into eternal slumber."
Chevalier
"She who seeks to know all between heaven and earth, Chevalier"
Me
Eternal slumber? Wait, for real!? Sakura...!?
Sakura
Zzzzzz, zzzzzzz...
Me
...Too late.
As I looked at Sakura, she was already slumped to the ground, sleeping soundly.
She seemed to have taken the full brunt of that Sandman's Curse or whatever, and she wouldn't wake up no matter how much I shook or called out to her.
Me
Looks like I have no choice but to go see Chevalier.
The book was one thing, but now I had to have her get rid of the curse on Sakura.
Sakura
Zzzzz, zzzzzz...
Me
How I wish I could just leave her like this. She just reaped what she saw after all.
Sakura
Zzzzz, zz-zzzzzzz...
ーー
The next day.
With Shikanosuke and Hebiko in tow as usual, I headed to Tokyo Kingdom to see Chevalier. However...
Onisaki Kirara
Hey! Where's the fights?
Me
Why would there be?!
For some reason, she came with us.
Onisaki Kirara-senpai.
She was a super-Taimanin who controlled both mighty ice powers and an Oni's strength.
We'd gotten to know each other when we were paired up on one of our previous missions.
Somehow, word reached her that we were going to Tokyo Kingdom, and she had tagged along with us saying that she wanted to have more combat experience before graduation.
Me
I told you I'm just seeing an alchemist I know, didn't I?
Kirara
You're full of it! I heard you just had a big fight with Nisha's shinobi the other day!
She must have meant the attack by Kuroki Shizuku during summer vacation.
He'd come after me, of all people, and after even Onigumo Saburo and Gaku Shonosuke joined the ruckus, it had become one hell of a situationーsupposedly.
I had only learned about it after the fact.
Me
I didn't do anything. I just heard from Library how he had to handle things when I was out.
Kirara
Hmph. You're the number one troublemaker in Gosha. What are you being so modest for!?
Kirara
You're an incident magnet. It doesn't matter at all whether you're aware of it or not!
Me
C'mon, incident magnet's a little much, isn't it?
Aishu Hebiko
Ehehe, she's right though.
Uehara Shikanosuke
You can't deny it, right?
Hebiko and Shikanosuke took Kirara-senpai's side.
Me
Not you guys too...
Kirara
Right!? Now, I need some accomplishments Mr. Magnet so call us some trouble. I'll freeze them all!
Kirara
Demons, monsters, whatever they are, come and get it!
Kirara-senpai made a show of putting her hands on her waist, brim with confidence.
She seemed to have no doubt that she'd have a chance to show off her skills if she stayed near me.
Me
Hey, Hebiko.
I called out to Hebiko in a hushed voice.
Hebiko
What's up, Fuma-chan?
Me
Keep a close eye on Kirara-senpai for me. She already doesn't blend in in so many ways, and now look at how excited she is...

She had big twintails decorated with her trademark ribbons and a super-sexy body with perfect hourglass proportions. On top of that, her Taima-suit was so excessively revealing that it left almost nothing to the imagination.
She stuck out worse than a sore thumb struck by a hammer.
Hebiko
It's alright. Kirara-senpai's strong.
Me
Listen, that's not the issue hereー
Shikanosuke
Huh? Where's Kirara-senpai?
Me & Hebiko
Ehhhhh!?
As Shikanosuke said, Kirara-senpai was gone.
Even though suddenly disappearing was typically Shikanosuke's role.
Shikanosuke
Oh! There she is!
As I looked in the direction Shikanosuke was pointing, I saw a group of suspicious-looking people talking to Kirara-senpai.
Suspicious Peddler (Male)
Now you can get a cosmetic treatment worth 50,000 yen, free of charge!
Suspicious Peddler (Male)
We'd love a bi-... beautiful woman like you to experience our service.
Suspicious Peddler (Female)
We're holding a special promotion. Now you can receive aphrod-... aroma mist treatment as well for that silky-smooth skin♪
Me
Hey, that's...
Hebiko
Looks like an Incubus and a Succubus.
Kirara
Hm-hm. You guys know what a girl wants. Let me hear a little more about it.
Kirara
If it sounds good, I'm willing to give it a try. Free of charge, of course.
A free trial of a special massage with beauty effects.
It sounded exactly like something out of porn videos, but Kirara-senpai appeared to be falling for it.
She was so ridiculously strong, and was even dressed like that, and yet did she not find this the least bit suspicious?
Shikanosuke
Th-This is bad, right Fuma!?
Me
Yeah, real bad! We gotta help her!!!
Hebiko
Kirara-senpai, noooo!
We'd hurriedly tried to cut into their talk, but other peddlers suddenly stood in our way.
Suspicious Peddlers (Male)

"""Hey, what're you brats doing?""
""Who the hell do you think you're messing with!?"""
Suspicious Peddler (Female)
I won't let you meddle in our business.
We had no choice but to defeat them.
If we didn't hurry, Kirara-senpai would be in big trouble.
